title: Two helpers
prompt: Write `square`, which draws a square of 20 with four corners, and use it twice from `run` with a `jump` of 30 in between.
hints: square is eight calls in a function; run is three lines.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func run():
	square()
	jump(30)
	square()

func square():
	move_forward(20)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(20)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(20)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(20)
	turn_left()
